title: Retention and eviction
requirements: 09.01. An unbounded journal retains every appended entry.
09.02. A bounded journal never retains more than `maxEntries`.
09.03. Appending beyond the limit removes the oldest retained entries.
09.05. Eviction does not reset, decrease, or reuse sequence numbers.
09.06. Boundary behavior is correct when `maxEntries` is 1.
